name: Seanwhite
source:
A prince who ran away from his new father, who is also a king and is after his life. He has since been living in the forest with Little People. "I will never return to the castle, because I'm happier here." said Seanwhite. 

But his sorrowful looks gave him away, it must be the complicated relationship with his stepfather. He is changing ever since he met you. How can he find his true happiness?
